paragraphs: Week 2 chose movement. Shannon’s Serving Punt climbed seven spots into the No. 1 chair with 114.66 points, so please update all throne-related correspondence accordingly.
The Waffles Special led the league with 138.48 points and claimed Winner of the Week honors. Sacks in the City was right behind at 137.46 and turned that total into a 42.28-point Steamroller win.
Whisk Takers jumped eight places to No. 7 and added a Giant Slayer badge, while Sammy’s Ball Handlers scored 117.52 only to receive the deeply unhelpful consolation prize of Hard Luck Hero.

NFL Week 1 also delivered a fresh round of injury and availability news, but without verified lineup evidence we are not assigning any of that real-football chaos credit—or blame—for these fantasy results.
Week 3, the floor is yours. Please be normal about it.
